mainEntity.name: How can I use my phone as a gamepad or game controller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Install PocketPad on your Android phone. Open a gamepad layout, connect via Bluetooth HID (no app on your PC) or Wi-Fi with PocketPad Companion on Windows, then play.

mainEntity.name: How do I use my phone as a remote keyboard and mouse for my PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select the Universal layout in PocketPad. Connect via Bluetooth HID or Wi-Fi for touchpad, typing, WASD keys, and keyboard shortcuts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use my phone as a TV remote control?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use PocketPad's Media Remote layout and pair via Bluetooth HID to control volume, playback, and navigation on TVs and media apps.

mainEntity.name: How can I use my phone as a presentation or slide controller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use PocketPad's Slide Controller layout: swipe to change slides and use buttons for fullscreen and black/white screen over Bluetooth HID.

mainEntity.name: Does PocketPad work without installing anything on my PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bluetooth HID requires no host software. Optionally install PocketPad Companion on Windows for lower Wi-Fi latency and multiplayer.

mainEntity.name: What is the best app to use my phone as a wireless game controller?

acceptedAnswer.text: PocketPad combines gamepad, keyboard/mouse, TV remote, and slide control with Bluetooth HID and optional Wi-Fi Companion for low latency and multiplayer.

mainEntity.name: Can multiple phones connect as controllers at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Multiple phones connect over Wi-Fi with PocketPad Companion; each appears as a separate Xbox controller on Windows.

mainEntity.name: Should I use Bluetooth or Wi‑Fi to connect PocketPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Bluetooth for instant pairing with no host install. Use Wi-Fi with Companion on Windows for discovery, pairing codes, lowest jitter, and multiplayer.

mainEntity.name: How do I connect PocketPad instantly via Bluetooth?

acceptedAnswer.text: In PocketPad choose Bluetooth, tap Prepare for pairing, add the phone from host Bluetooth settings, then pick a layout.

mainEntity.name: How do I connect PocketPad over Wi‑Fi with Companion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Install Companion on Windows, allow firewall, same Wi-Fi, connect from the app; enter the 6-digit code for Universal keyboard/mouse layouts.

mainEntity.name: Does PocketPad work with Steam and PC games?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PocketPad emulates standard gamepad or keyboard/mouse input for Steam and PC games that support those devices.

mainEntity.name: Does PocketPad work on Mac and Linux?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bluetooth HID works on Mac and Linux with no extra software. PocketPad Companion is for Windows only.

mainEntity.name: Can I control a Smart TV or Android TV with PocketPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes via Bluetooth HID with Media Remote or Universal layouts if the TV supports HID input.

mainEntity.name: How low is PocketPad's latency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bluetooth HID is responsive for gaming; Wi-Fi with Companion is optimized for low jitter on the same LAN.

mainEntity.name: Can I use my phone as a gamepad without a server app on my computer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bluetooth HID mode needs no server or companion on the host, unlike many Wi-Fi-only controller apps.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an account to use PocketPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: No account is required. Settings and layouts are stored on your device.

mainEntity.name: Does PocketPad work offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bluetooth and LAN Wi-Fi work without internet.

mainEntity.name: Is PocketPad free? What is PocketPad Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Core features are free. Pro removes ads and adds cosmetic skins via Google Play billing.

mainEntity.name: Why does Windows Companion mention ViGEmBus?

acceptedAnswer.text: ViGEmBus lets Windows see virtual Xbox controllers. The installer adds it only when missing.

mainEntity.name: PocketPad won't connect over Wi‑Fi — firewall help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Allow Companion on private networks in Windows Firewall and ensure phone and PC share the same LAN (not guest-isolated Wi-Fi).

mainEntity.name: My PC doesn't show PocketPad in Bluetooth — what should I try?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tap Prepare for pairing in the app, clear old pairings, and scan again from the host Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: My game doesn't recognize PocketPad as a controller

acceptedAnswer.text: Use a gamepad layout; on Windows Wi-Fi ensure Companion and ViGEmBus are running. Some games only accept XInput controllers.

mainEntity.name: Why do I need to pair again after switching layouts or modes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gamepad and keyboard/mouse use different Bluetooth HID profiles; most OSes require re-pairing after switching.

mainEntity.name: Does PocketPad collect my controller inputs or layouts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Controller inputs and layouts are not sent to Datron servers. Optional anonymous analytics are described in the Privacy Policy.

mainEntity.name: Is PocketPad the same as the Pocket-Pad app on GitHub?

acceptedAnswer.text: PocketPad by Datron is a separate full-featured app, not affiliated with similarly named GitHub projects.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize button layouts and create my own presets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use the layout editor to drag, resize controls, clone presets, and save profiles.

mainEntity.name: Can I steer racing games with phone tilt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tilt-to-steer maps phone orientation to steering on supported gamepad layouts.
